items.rationale: These fittings are necessary for the repair of the failed copper heating pipe in the plant room, which is directly related to the insured escape of water peril (2.4.2, 7.1.7c). Only the affected pipework is covered.
As above, these are standard fittings for the pipe repair in the affected area. Covered as part of the necessary repair (2.4.2, 7.1.7c).
Standard fitting for the pipe repair in the affected area, covered under the same logic as above (2.4.2, 7.1.7c).
Minor fixings and fastenings required for the pipe repair are covered as consumables (7.1.7c).
Pipe clamps are necessary to secure the new pipework in the affected area, covered as part of the repair (7.1.7c).
Replacement copper pipe for the affected section is covered as part of the repair (2.4.2, 7.1.7c).
Labour for the pipe repair in the affected plant room is covered (7.1.7g). Only the portion directly related to the insured damage is indemnified; hours for unrelated work are not.
Helper labour for the pipe repair is covered as part of the necessary repair (7.1.7g). Only the portion directly related to the insured damage is indemnified.
Replacement insulation for the repaired pipe is covered as part of restoring the affected section to its pre-loss standard (7.1.7c).
Consumable material for securing insulation or pipework, covered as part of the repair (7.1.7c).
General small parts and consumables for the pipe repair are covered (7.1.7c), provided they relate to the affected area.
One call-out charge per contractor per invoice is covered (7.1.7f). Reference cases show typical indemnified values.
Disposal of debris generated by the pipe repair is covered (5.2.1, 7.1.7a). Only waste from the affected area is indemnified.
